multimodal_policy.description: The proposed model requires both ECG and respiratory inputs (Section 3.4.2). A record is eligible only if it provides an airflow channel, per the strict airflow decision.

datasets_excluded_from_multimodal.Apnea-ECG: ECG-only: all 70 base records contain a single ECG channel at 100 Hz; no respiratory channel.

excluded_records.ucddb005: Flow channel unusable: std 0.503 vs 4.2-6.0 in other UCDDB records, only 318 unique values, flat after initial transient. Excluded rather than substituted with an effort channel, preserving the strict airflow policy.

ecg.notch: detected mains frequency (50/60 Hz), Q=30, applied when peak/neighbour ratio >= 3
